summary: Make production promotion consume complete staging evidence instead of debugging release automation live.
details: Commit 9b37082a23d544dc9458b5ef47c03da6da5c684a defines the future release method: build and verify one immutable image in CI, exercise the exact release through production-equivalent isolated staging, bind one owner approval to the staging receipt, and perform only a bounded production replacement and read-only canary. Fresh backups, restore rehearsals, full authority comparisons, and writer replacement are reserved for mechanically classified maintenance or recovery work.
operator_impact: Do not start another production release until automation emits and verifies the required end-to-end staging receipt. Routine app and non-migrating security-configuration releases should then require one promotion approval and complete within their bounded cutover budgets.
